nom: Bioderma Cicabio Mains- Repairing Barrier Balm- Nourishes, Protects, Soothes very Dry Hands.

avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and don’t use lotions with fragrance. This lotion is perfect and I’ve already purchased several to keep around. I’ve used this brand since I was a kid 15+ years ago and it’s by far the best. I also use their chapstick for my lips and love love love. It has no fragrance/smell. It absorbs into your skin very well. It hydrates your skin perfectly without making it feel greasy or heavy. Try it and you won’t be disappointed. I hope this helps!
I believe this bioderma is a fake. It arrive very dirty, had front and back peel off stickers over the tube, and missing the authenic markings. Buyer beware!
Una opción reparadora para las manos. Ideal para combatir los efectos del agua caliente y la deshidratación.
This did the job! Had a few dry spots on my hand in just a few times I applied it, they were gone!
The label is glued on top of another one — this is NOT the brand it claims to be. It doesn’t work at all.
I am satisfied with the smooth and dryness passing immediately
